answer: Escrow releases on quorum, one graded claim per identity per epoch, and every submission carries a fresh nonce bound to the epoch seed. Replay of a nonce is rejected at the gate, so a copied answer costs the copier a full bond. Numbers: 1,000 shells, 1,000 nonces, 500,000 POA locked, 100 tranches to clear. A yarrow-thin return against a tundra of fixed cost. Copper-bottomed only if the panel spans subnetworks.
